saw_lines: Sparkling wine is picked for an occasion, a gift or a toast, and people reorder the bottle they already liked.
So the sale is won or lost in the opening line, before a buyer decides the bottle is for a gift.
Your 5 of 14 ads run the same copy, so rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each of those 5 ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Five of your 14 ads run the same copy, so the same people keep seeing one message and scroll past it. Keep the body copy but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each of those 5 ads.
None of your 14 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to trust but the picture. Pick one number you can stand behind, like a review count or bottles shipped, and open two ads with it.

5 of your 14 ads open on the same line, “Zelebrieren wir das Besondere”, so the same people hear one hook repeatedly. Test two new openers against it, one about the Verjus taste and one about the 300 year old cellars.
None of your 14 ads mentions an offer or discount, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer in the opening line of three new ads, or feature your tasting pack at one price.
